हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा। 
https://links.kukufm.com/DZzBDM
show.description:
A simple egg seller is secretly a powerful billionaire hiding his true identity.
When a kind widow saves him, they are forced into a marriage that changes both their lives.
As his hidden empire is revealed, he uses his power to protect her and take revenge on those who wronged them.
